verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs describe integrating with the cloud stack and continuously monitoring systems, with automated evidence collection, through integrations such as JumpCloud and FreeAgent offboarding checks plus access-check monitoring. However, the claims are high-level marketing statements. The AI gap-analysis feature, which flags outdated timestamps and irrelevant screenshots, also implies manual screenshot uploads remain part of the workflow. Missing for 10: documented collection schedules/frequency, description of timestamped machine-gathered evidence artifacts, explicit replacement of screenshots/CSVs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
